title: O Lord My God, You Are Very Great

questions.question: Bless the Lord, O my soul! O Lord my God, you are very what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:1 (ESV): "Bless the Lord, O my soul! O Lord my God, you are very great!"

questions.question: You are clothed with splendor and majesty, covering yourself with light as with a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:2 (ESV): "covering yourself with light as with a garment,"

questions.question: He stretches out the heavens like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:2 (ESV): "stretching out the heavens like a tent."

questions.question: He makes the clouds his chariot; he rides on the wings of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:3 (ESV): "...he rides on the wings of the wind;"

questions.question: He makes his messengers winds, his ministers a flaming what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:4 (ESV): "he makes his messengers winds, his ministers a flaming fire."

questions.question: He set the earth on its foundations, so that it should never be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:5 (ESV): "He set the earth on its foundations, so that it should never be moved."

questions.question: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:6 (ESV): "...the waters stood above the mountains."

questions.question: You make springs gush forth in the valleys; they flow between the what?
You cause the grass to grow for the livestock and plants for man to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:14 (ESV): "...and plants for man to cultivate,"

questions.question: Wine to gladden the heart of man, oil to make his face shine and bread to strengthen man's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:15 (ESV): "...and bread to strengthen man's heart."

questions.question: The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from whom?
Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:23 (ESV): "Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening."

questions.question: O Lord, how manifold are your works! In wisdom have you made them all; the earth is full of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:24 (ESV): "...the earth is full of your creatures."

questions.question: When you open your hand, they are filled with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:28 (ESV): "...when you open your hand, they are filled with good things."

questions.question: When you take away their breath, they die and return to their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 104:29 (ESV): "...they die and return to their dust."

key_verse_text: O Lord, how manifold are your works! In wisdom have you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
